channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 21 sources (18 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: SDK TypeScript Release sdk-typescript-v0.1.39
item.description: Qwen Code's TypeScript SDK ships v0.1.39, bundling CLI versions 0.28.7 and 0.28.6 so developers can integrate it directly through the SDK.

item.title: Release v0.28.6
item.description: Managed sessions can now pause while waiting on tool approvals, questions, or Hooks and MCP decisions, and pick up again after a Harness restart through cold recovery.

item.title: Release v0.28.7
item.description: Qwen Code CLI lands on the Harness kernel, usage statistics stay off unless you opt in, and repeated tool-call rejections now come with clearer explanations.

item.title: SDK TypeScript Release v0.1.36
item.description: Qwen Code's TypeScript SDK reaches v0.1.36, bundling CLI 0.28.6 so developers can call on Qwen Code's capabilities directly from their projects.

item.title: v2.77.0 (2026-11-27)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.77.0 adds SQLite, Postgres and MongoDB backends for conversation storage, renames the session store, skips missing skill libraries by default with advice, and makes cross-provider thinking summaries easier to read.

item.title: SDK v0.2.2
item.description: Cline SDK v0.2.2 cleans up internal telemetry, trimming related exports and dependencies.

item.title: desktop-v0.0.51
item.description: Cline's desktop app ships maintenance release v0.0.51.

item.title: v4.1.28
item.description: Cline ships v4.1.28, refreshing its model list so the OpenAI provider drops IDs the upstream catalog has marked deprecated.

item.title: v2.76.0 (2026-11-26)
item.description: Realtime sessions can now reveal tools mid-conversation, requests to Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash trigger deprecation warnings, and Pax adds computer-use desktop sandboxes.

item.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
item.description: Hugging Face moved LTX-2.5 onto AWS Trainium3 with tensor and sequence parallelism, generating a 10-second 2048x1024 clip with sound in about 22 seconds on half the machine, matching the paid API, and built a shot-chaining workflow for drafting short films along the way.

item.title: CLI v3.0.76
item.description: Cline CLI v3.0.76 bundles a single third-party notice at the npm package root covering every platform binary, refreshes the built-in model catalog, and drops upstream-removed models from the OpenAI picker.

item.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
item.description: Hugging Face launched a public dashboard to compare llama.cpp prompt processing and generation speed across hardware, models, and quantization settings on AMD Ryzen and Radeon, and to track performance changes across builds.
